title: Autofix engine: act on unit-failure events
description: Connect systemd unit-failure events (already subscribed via monitors -> services JobRemoved) to the remediation tier using the act/ask matrix: safe+reversible -> auto-remediate with undo-after; else the one rare push. Plumbing exists; policy does not. See docs/ux.md.

title: Real test harness
description: Fakes for Ollama/LiteLLM/D-Bus + dispatch-branch coverage + golden transcripts. Coverage is smoke-level + 1 integration test today; thin on llm paths, remote tool-loop, monitors, cli, safety socket.

title: Helper returns exit=None on non-helper-changing switch
description: Detached helper returned exit None on a successful switch where the helper did NOT restart (nixlap beads add). Rebuild unit was active-exited. Verify _run_rebuild exit reporting / follower completion when the helper survives.

title: UI toolkit decision: libcosmic vs GTK
description: Native-correct is libcosmic (iced) for the COSMIC lock; GTK fallback. Decide after the interaction model. Notifications+ledger are toolkit-agnostic and shippable first.

title: Kept-well ledger
description: Looked-after-itself-for-N-days + quiet tally; pull-only, glance-moment (lock screen). Data = audit trail + detectors. docs/ux.md.

title: Daemon supervision: Restart + watchdog
description: systemd Restart=on-failure + backoff; WatchdogSec/sd_notify so a hung daemon restarts, not just a crashed one.

title: Remediation: offer-after-diagnosis path
description: Want-me-to-restart-it after a diagnosis, then yes. Needs light conversational state.

title: Remediation: restart-loop detection
description: Do not offer a restart systemd already retried and lost (check NRestarts); route to needs-a-real-fix.

title: Remediation: session relogin / reboot
description: Offer relogin/reboot for the rebuild_skew/EGL case (graphics broken after a rebuild).

title: Remediation: system units via root helper
description: Restart failed SYSTEM units via the privileged helper. remediation.py is user-units-only today.

title: Desktop notifications + offered fix (2b)
description: org.freedesktop.Notifications with action buttons wired to the Confirm protocol; model-phrased diagnosis on fire. proactive-detectors-plan.md 2b.

title: New-coredump detector
description: Poll coredumpctl; fire on dumps newer than last-seen. Spec: proactive-detectors-plan.md 2a.

title: Process-vanished detector (the 20 percent)
description: Poll liveness for non-unit process exits (the cosmic-panel/dock case; no signal anywhere). Dynamic baseline; fire when a baselined component vanishes. Spec: docs/proactive-detectors-plan.md 2a.

title: hello.ready remote accuracy
description: hello.ready/remote is advertised optimistically; reflect real remote readiness instead of surfacing auth failures per-call.

title: Remote chain enablement (proxy / API base)
description: Wire a Hermes proxy or API base/key so the remote tool-calling chain works. defaultChain=local works without it today.

title: CI: GitHub Actions running nix flake check
description: Run nix flake check on push/PR.

title: Machine-profile ContextProvider
description: No built-in machine-profile ContextProvider is registered (interface ready, none supplied). System-prompt assembly has no machine context.

title: Voice as primary invoke
description: Voice invoke for the non-technical user (text = the nerd tool). Flips voice-later ordering.

title: No home of its own vs invoke surface
description: Fold intelligence into native surfaces vs a single light summonable invoke surface. docs/ux.md.

title: Prefetch echoes full multiline command into context
description: prefetch prints the whole cmd string, dumping multiline scripts into model context (noise/dilution). Label by fetcher name instead.

title: Lazy litellm import
description: Keep litellm lazy-imported so the local-only path never loads the heavy remote-surface dep.

title: Helper read timeout in _run_helper
description: Timeout in safety._run_helper so a stuck helper cannot hang the daemon.

title: Version the client-daemon wire protocol
description: Wire protocol has no version in hello (module ABI does); a stale client should fail loud.

title: Self-healing worktrees: prune at startup
description: SIGKILL mid-validation leaks a worktree; run git worktree prune at daemon start.

title: edit_packages property tests
description: hypothesis: add idempotent; add+remove round-trips; remove-absent raises; list delimiters survive.

title: Error-rate spike / OOM / baseline persistence (2c)
description: Deferred fuzzy detectors and persisted baseline. proactive-detectors-plan.md 2c.

title: History backend (sqlite)
description: History is NullHistory only; SessionState scratch works. Add a persistent backend when needed.

title: GitHub-native self-curating issue intake
description: Agent triages GH issues: dedup via embeddings, link duplicates, label, request repro, restate. Embrace AI-authored tickets. docs/ideas.md. Speculative.
